contracts: Each obligation has an independent executed behavior assertion in the declared C# test class. Python selectors invoke existing scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and verify their own exact fully qualified tests in current-invocation TRX, completed outcomes and assertion-specific failure identity. Baseline tests compile against existing public entrypoints; additive capabilities are accessed through the real composition/store object at runtime. No absent production type may cause RED. Build/restore errors, missing selected tests, stale TRX, reflection binding errors without a behavior observation, aborts/skips and timeouts are harness failures. GREEN requires all declared positive/negative persisted-state assertions. Use temporary SQLite/workspaces only. Same-host success proves neither Windows Runner isolation nor remote notification transport.
selector_intents: Author tests/s2_06/test_node_authority.py::test_invalid_home_never_relocates_resources bound to executed PhaseA.Platform.Tests.NodeIdentity.NodeAuthorityTests.InvalidHomeCannotSilentlyRelocateResources. Use real temporary store/project/package/snapshot records and existing public operation entrypoints with forged/missing/mismatched homes, instrumenting process launch only to prove zero dispatch. Compare actual persisted ownership, files and destination absence. RED is a completed denial/unchanged-state behavior assertion; no missing new production class, placeholder guard or source-text match supplies RED.
